_comment: Curated CAPN3 and DMD evidence bundles (Milestones 1 and 4). CAPN3_c.550del is grounded in a real ClinVar entry (coordinates not independently verified — see notes); all other cases are synthetic, constructed to exercise specific combining-rule paths and, from Milestone 4 on, case-level trans/cis/hemizygous interpretation. Expected results live separately in validation/golden_cases/variant_golden_cases.yaml (variant-level) and case_interpretation_golden_cases.yaml (case-level).

gene_disease_context.disease: Limb-girdle muscular dystrophy, type R1 calpain3-related (LGMDR1 / calpainopathy)

specification.version: ClinGen LGMD VCEP Specifications to the ACMG/AMP Guidelines for CAPN3, v2.0 (2025-07-09; DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21434844)

cases.notes: Real ClinVar entry (Variation ID 17621), reported Pathogenic. Known founder mutation, reported to account for up to ~75% of abnormal CAPN3 alleles in some European (esp. Northern Spanish / Basque and other Southern/Western European) populations — this is why ancestry_specific_max_af is meaningfully higher than overall_af rather than roughly equal. PM2 (absent/extremely low frequency) is written up here as MET in the golden case using the low overall AF (0.023%), but a curator reviewing this case should not treat that as settled: PM2 is defined around population rarity, and a founder allele that is locally common in the tested individual's ancestry group is a weaker fit for 'extremely low frequency' than the global AF alone suggests. This is exactly the ancestry-stratification nuance the ACMG Engine Detailed Design Guide flags for PM2 (Section 7, 'Population frequency thresholds'); a real evaluator should key its threshold check off ancestry_specific_max_af, not overall_af, once ancestry is known. Flagged for manual review in the golden case rather than silently trusted. Exact GRCh38 coordinates were not independently verified during curation (see variant.coordinate_verified=false); HGVS (c.550del) and the ClinVar accession are used as the authoritative identifiers instead.

cases.notes: Fully synthetic — built in Milestone 4 specifically to pair with CAPN3_SYNTH_PATHOGENIC_01 in a case-level trans/cis/unknown-phase test (see data/curated/clinical_cases.json and clinical.py). Same evidence pattern as CAPN3_SYNTH_PATHOGENIC_01 (frameshift + NMD predicted + absent from gnomAD) but a distinct position/HGVS, so the two are independently classified rather than literal duplicates. Not a real ClinVar variant. UPDATED in batch 4 (real ClinGen LGMD VCEP CAPN3 threshold adoption): computational_evidence (PP3, calibrated pathogenic) was added here specifically because PVS1 (Very Strong) + PM2 alone is no longer enough to reach a qualifying tier once PM2's real VCEP strength for CAPN3 is Supporting rather than Moderate — Table 5 has no rule for '1 Very Strong + 1 Supporting' alone. Adding PP3 (Supporting) gives '1 Very Strong + >=2 Supporting', which IS a Table 5 Pathogenic path, preserving this fixture's role as a clean, individually-qualifying trans partner for CASE_CAPN3_BIALLELIC_TRANS. This is a deliberate design choice disclosed here, not a silent fix — see config/population_thresholds.yaml's threshold_source note for why the unmodified combination would no longer qualify, and CAPN3_c.1939G>T in variant_golden_cases.yaml for a REAL variant where this same gap was left unmodified and shown honestly instead.

cases.notes: Real ClinVar entry (Variation ID 217153, RCV000201136), reported Pathogenic, nonsense variant in exon 17. gnomAD v4.1.0 overall AF ~0.00003 (0.003%). nmd_predicted=true is a modeling judgment, not a direct NMD-prediction tool output: exon 17 is mid-transcript (CAPN3/NM_000070 has 24 exons), well upstream of the last exon-exon junction, so NMD is the biologically expected outcome for a nonsense variant at this position. Exact GRCh38 coordinates were not independently verified during curation (see variant.coordinate_verified=false); HGVS and the ClinVar accession are used as the authoritative identifiers instead, same convention as CAPN3_c.550del.

gene_disease_context.disease: Limb-girdle muscular dystrophy, type R1 calpain3-related (LGMDR1 / calpainopathy)

specification.version: ClinGen LGMD VCEP Specifications to the ACMG/AMP Guidelines for CAPN3, v2.0 (2025-07-09; DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21434844)

cases.notes: Real, recurrent CAPN3 missense variant (p.Asp753Asn, ClinVar VCV000281081), reported in multiple LGMD cohorts (e.g. an 8-patient Italian multicenter series) but with real, documented controversy: gnomAD v4.1.0 AF (0.002457, driven by a Middle Eastern subpopulation) clears the real ClinGen LGMD VCEP BS1 threshold (>0.001), and several reported carriers had a second CAPN3 variant that could independently explain their phenotype (PM3, PP4 not met per the VCEP's own curation). UPDATED in batch 8: found the real LGMD VCEP's own current classification for this exact variant via web search -- LIKELY BENIGN, via BS1 + BP2 (LGMD VCEP specification version 2.0.0, variant curation approved 2025-10-28, per search summary; not independently verified against the primary erepo.clinicalgenome.org record the way CAPN3_c.2120A>G was, so treat the exact BP2 rationale and precise approval date as secondhand rather than primary-source-confirmed). This project cannot reproduce that call: BP2 ('in trans with a pathogenic variant for a recessive disorder... or in cis') is not implemented here at all, and even BS1 alone is Table-5-insufficient for LIKELY_BENIGN without a Supporting-benign criterion alongside it. Also added this batch: a real REVEL score (0.649) as computational_evidence -- below the real VCEP's PP3 threshold (>=0.70) but above its BP4 threshold (<=0.10), so genuinely INDETERMINATE by the calibrated-score model this project uses (not PATHOGENIC, not BENIGN) -- the project's first real fixture to exercise that middle ground, where PP3 and BP4 both correctly return NOT_MET rather than one of them guessing. This is a case where the real VCEP's own point-based system reaches a confident benign-side call (via case-level BP2 evidence this project doesn't implement) that a purely variant-level, 6-criterion engine using Table 5 genuinely cannot reach -- the mirror image of CAPN3_c.1939G>T and CAPN3_SYNTH_PATHOGENIC_02's pathogenic-side gap. gene_disease_context here is fixed as AUTOSOMAL_RECESSIVE for all CAPN3 variants in this project; recent (2025) literature separately proposing this variant may reflect a low-penetrance AUTOSOMAL DOMINANT mechanism is a possibility this project's one-inheritance-pattern-per-gene design still cannot represent, noted here as before rather than silently dropped now that other findings have been added.

gene_disease_context.disease: Limb-girdle muscular dystrophy, type R1 calpain3-related (LGMDR1 / calpainopathy)

specification.version: ClinGen LGMD VCEP Specifications to the ACMG/AMP Guidelines for CAPN3, v2.0 (2025-07-09; DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21434844)

cases.notes: Real ClinVar entry (Variation ID 21036, RCV000020097), reported Pathogenic, canonical splice acceptor variant in intron 6. Reported absent from ExAC/gnomAD. Experimental splicing studies (per ClinVar submitter evidence) confirm this variant disrupts mRNA splicing -- real, strong evidence for pathogenicity that this project's PVS1 evaluator cannot use, since it only auto-resolves frameshift/nonsense NMD cases; splice variants are deliberately routed to MANUAL_REVIEW (see pvs1.py). This fixture exists specifically to show that limitation on a real, well-documented pathogenic variant, not just a hypothetical one: our 6-criterion engine lands on VUS here (PM2 MET alone is insufficient per Table 5) despite this being a confidently Pathogenic variant in ClinVar with experimental support.

Real ClinVar entry (Variation ID 11222, RCV000011973), reported Pathogenic, nonsense variant, absent from gnomAD. The project's first real (non-synthetic) DMD fixture -- DMD_SYNTH_PATHOGENIC_01 remains synthetic and is still what the Milestone 4 ClinicalCase fixtures reference; this variant is not yet wired into a clinical case. nmd_predicted=true is a modeling judgment (dystrophin is ~3685 aa; position 768 is early-mid transcript, well upstream of the last exon-exon junction), same convention as CAPN3_c.1939G>T. Exon number not independently verified during curation, so omitted rather than guessed; HGVS and the ClinVar accession are the authoritative identifiers.

cases.notes: Real CAPN3 missense variant, gnomAD v4.1.0 AF ~0.00000263 -- well below this project's PM2 threshold and reported by ClinVar itself as Uncertain Significance. No computational evidence gathered here (left absent rather than fabricated). Included deliberately as a case where this project's limited 6-criterion engine's VUS call actually agrees with the real-world ClinVar consensus, unlike CAPN3_c.1939G>T and CAPN3_c.946-1G>A (both real Pathogenic variants our engine under-calls due to scope gaps) -- useful to have at least one case in the set that isn't a story about the engine's limitations.

cases.notes: Real ClinVar entry (Variation ID 553754), reported Pathogenic, canonical splice donor variant in intron 18, observed in homozygous and compound heterozygous LGMD patients. gnomAD AF ~0.01%. Complements CAPN3_c.946-1G>A (a splice ACCEPTOR variant) -- together they show the PVS1-splice-scope gap (see pvs1.py, 'PVS1 scope') isn't a one-off on a single variant: two independent real, confidently-Pathogenic splice variants both land on VUS here because PVS1 correctly declines to auto-resolve splice-site consequences.

gene_disease_context.disease: Limb-girdle muscular dystrophy, type R1 calpain3-related (LGMDR1 / calpainopathy)

specification.version: ClinGen LGMD VCEP Specifications to the ACMG/AMP Guidelines for CAPN3, v2.0 (2025-07-09; DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21434844)

cases.notes: Real CAPN3 missense variant, absent from gnomAD/ExAC, reported by ClinVar as Uncertain Significance and never reported in the CAPN3-related-disease literature. Individual in-silico tools (SIFT: Tolerated, PolyPhen-2: Benign, Align-GVGD: Class C0) all lean benign, and the substituted residue is conserved as leucine in other mammals -- but deliberately NOT converted into a ComputationalEvidence record here: this project's PP3/BP4 model expects a single calibrated ensemble score (e.g. REVEL), not raw individual-tool outputs stacked together, which is exactly the kind of multi-tool-vote pattern the design guide warns against (see computational_evidence.py docstring). Left as PP3/BP4 NOT_EVALUATED rather than retrofitting a categorical PolyPhen-2 call into a model built for something else. PM2 MET alone (absent from a well-covered locus) is the only criterion that applies, so this lands on VUS -- agreeing with ClinVar's own call, like CAPN3_c.1343G>A.

gene_disease_context.disease: Limb-girdle muscular dystrophy, type R1 calpain3-related (LGMDR1 / calpainopathy)

specification.version: ClinGen LGMD VCEP Specifications to the ACMG/AMP Guidelines for CAPN3, v2.0 (2025-07-09; DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21434844)

cases.notes: Real ClinVar entry (VCV001453744 / RCV002002571), reported Pathogenic (last evaluated 2023-10-06, criteria provided/single submitter). GRCh38 chr15:42359806 A>G, NM_000070.3:c.1A>G, disrupting CAPN3's initiator Met codon directly (ClinVar molecular consequence: missense_variant + initiator_codon_variant). Coordinates independently confirmed via NCBI eutils esummary (canonical_spdi NC_000015.10:42359805:A:G), not just taken from a search snippet. gnomAD reported two slightly different exome AF figures in the ClinVar record (0.00001 and 0.00000, likely different gnomAD releases/subsets aggregated by ClinVar); the higher, more conservative value is used here. No ancestry-specific breakdown was available from this summary, so ancestry_specific_max_af is left unset (not the same as 'checked and found absent'). This is the project's first real start-loss (initiator codon) fixture -- PVS1's third documented scope gap, alongside the two splice-site fixtures (CAPN3_c.946-1G>A, CAPN3_c.2050+1G>A): the evaluator declines to auto-resolve start-loss variants because doing so correctly requires checking for a plausible downstream alternative in-frame start codon, which this project does not model (see pvs1.py, 'PVS1 scope'). Real ClinGen LGMD VCEP CAPN3 PVS1 flowchart likely does resolve this branch; this project's PVS1 evaluator does not implement that flowchart.

cases.notes: Real ClinVar entry (VCV000468648 / ClinGen Allele Registry CA7511744), classified Pathogenic by the ClinGen LGMD VCEP itself (Evidence Repository record 7f534c0d-0dbe-4d2e-88e2-88c804cde635, approved 2025-04-22): erepo.clinicalgenome.org/evrepo/ui/interpretation/7f534c0d-0dbe-4d2e-88e2-88c804cde635. This is the project's first fixture sourced directly from an official VCEP expert curation record, not just a ClinVar aggregate classification -- and the first REAL calibrated computational (REVEL) score used anywhere in this project (closing a gap open since Milestone 1): REVEL=0.966, well above the real VCEP's own PP3 threshold (>=0.70). Population data: gnomAD v2.1.1 total AF 0.000148 (42/282854, all populations); gnomAD v4.1.0 exomes East Asian filtering allele frequency 0.001250-0.001929 (95% CI bounds, 62/39700 East Asian chromosomes) -- used here as ancestry_specific_max_af (upper bound, consistent with the FAF convention already used for PM2/BA1/BS1 in this project). NOTABLE: the real VCEP's own curation explicitly found this variant's East Asian FAF (0.001929) technically crosses their BS1 threshold (>0.001), but chose NOT to apply BS1 -- an explicit 'BS1 exception' -- because this is one of the most commonly reported CAPN3 variants in East Asian LGMD patients (i.e. a real, expert-judged founder-pathogenic-variant scenario, not a benign-common-variant one). This project's BS1 evaluator cannot make that judgment call (it has no access to case-count/segregation context), but it does correctly decline to auto-resolve: with overall_af below the BS1 threshold but ancestry_specific_max_af crossing it, the evaluator's existing founder-enrichment branch returns MANUAL_REVIEW rather than silently applying BS1 -- landing on exactly the same 'a human needs to look at this' conclusion the real VCEP reached, for the same underlying reason, without knowing why. The real variant's actual Pathogenic classification rests almost entirely on criteria this project's 6-criterion engine does not implement at all (PM3_Strong: observed in trans with a pathogenic variant across multiple case reports; PP1_Strong: segregation in 6 affected relatives across 4 families; PP4: phenotype + reduced calpain-3 protein expression) -- PM2 is explicitly NOT_MET in the real curation too (too common in East Asian populations for PM2_Supporting's <0.0001 threshold), and PP3 (REVEL) is the ONLY real criterion this project's engine and the real VCEP curation share. This fixture is included specifically to show, honestly, how much of a real clinical classification depends on case-level and segregation evidence entirely outside a variant-only automated engine's reach.

population_evidence.source_version: unspecified (per ClinVar submitter note: 'not present in population databases, ExAC no frequency')

cases.notes: Real ClinVar entry (RCV000379611.3, current record 299395779), reported Pathogenic by Invitae (Sherloc method, 1-star 'criteria provided, single submitter' review status, last evaluated 2017-07-31), canonical splice donor variant disrupting intron 2 of DMD. Coordinates independently confirmed directly from the ClinVar RCV page (GRCh38 chrX:33020138 C>T; DMD is on the minus strand, so this genomic C>T is the transcript-level c.93+1G>A). Reported absent from population databases (ExAC) in the submitter's own description; no gnomAD-specific frequency was stated in the available record, so ExAC is recorded as the source here rather than assumed to be gnomAD. This is the project's second real (non-synthetic) DMD variant, and the first real DMD fixture exercising PVS1's splice-site scope gap (previously only demonstrated on CAPN3, via CAPN3_c.946-1G>A and CAPN3_c.2050+1G>A) -- showing the same evaluator limitation applies identically regardless of gene, since pvs1.py's splice-donor/acceptor handling has no gene-specific logic. With PVS1 returning MANUAL_REVIEW and only PM2 (Moderate, absent from ExAC) MET, the engine lands on VUS, the same story as the CAPN3 splice fixtures, now confirmed on the X-linked gene too.
